firstOrderIndependentReference.geometry: Every native Beam sample is straight to a single front interface, refracts into the positive-index half-plane, reflects at a finite vertical mirror inside that same medium, exits through the same interface and crosses the source-side detector again. Actual propagation is never prescribed.
